explanation: Mathlib provides `WeierstrassCurve.isUnit_Δ` and `integralModel_Δ_eq`, but neither states the nonvanishing of the principal ideal generated by the integral discriminant. Turning those facts into this ideal statement requires additional steps, so it does not meet the one- or two-line special-case criterion. I searched Mathlib’s elliptic-curve files for local-minimal-discriminant results and discriminant nonvanishing lemmas.
